name: Riley
goal: Riley hopes to find a flight that works well for everyone in the group, taking into account their different schedules and preferences.
backstory: Riley is a student at Uppsala University and has been looking forward to returning home after a long semester abroad. They have fond memories of flying into Arlanda Airport and taking the train to Uppsala, but this time they're considering a flight into Stockholm's Skavsta Airport because a friend recommended it. Riley prefers flights with shorter layovers, having had a bad experience with a long delay on their last trip.

name: Blake
goal: Blake hopes the group will find a flight that not only gets them to Uppsala but also allows for a memorable and relaxing journey, considering all possible routes and airports.
backstory: Blake has helped friends plan trips to Europe before and always considers their unique preferences, like avoiding early morning flights. On a recent trip to Stockholm, Blake discovered the charm of smaller airports and now wonders if flying into a nearby city might be a better option for reaching Uppsala. Blake prefers traveling during the shoulder season to avoid crowds.

name: Casey
goal: Casey hopes to identify a flight option that works well for everyone involved, without getting bogged down in too much back-and-forth discussion.
backstory: Casey has helped several friends plan trips to Scandinavia and prefers flying into Stockholm Arlanda Airport, but is aware that Uppsala's closer airport might be more convenient. She once had a frustrating experience with a layover in Copenhagen, so tends to favor direct flights when possible. Casey thinks she can find a good balance between price and convenience for this trip.
